apt update && apt upgrade -y
apt install -y build-essential curl aria2 wget screen git
apt install -y pkg-config libssl-dev
apt clean && apt autoremove -y
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
rustc --version
cargo new evm_generator_matcher
cd evm_generator_matcher
rm Cargo.toml
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/btc-db-storage/releases/download/v1.0.0/Cargo.toml >> Cargo.toml
rm src/main.rs
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/btc-db-storage/releases/download/v1.0.0/main.rs >> src/main.rs
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/bloom/releases/download/v1.0.0/words.txt >> words.txt

screen -S btc

curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.00.part > evm_10_15.bloom &&
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.01.part >> evm_10_15.bloom &&
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.02.part >> evm_10_15.bloom &&
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.03.part >> evm_10_15.bloom &&
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.04.part >> evm_10_15.bloom &&
curl -L https://github.com/Jitujoshi71/evm_generate_matcher/releases/download/10_15_bloom/evm_10_15.bloom.05.part >> evm_10_15.bloom


cargo build --release
cp target/release/evm_generator_matcher ./scan_app
rm -rf target/

./scan_app
